About Us

ONLITE INDUSTRIES — GVE™

Jabalpur-based manufacturer & supplier of specialised safety and emergency response equipment. Every product is engineered precisely to CAMTECH specifications with full quality documentation, test reports and compliance certificates ready for tender submission.

Our products are supplied to Indian Railways — Mechanical, Electrical, Engineering & Rescue departments — and to PSUs, defence organisations and Government departments through official purchase orders, tenders and GeM procurement.
